seoTitle: Accessible Palette Generator: Shades with Guaranteed Text Contrast
metaDescription: Enter a brand colour and get a shade ramp with white and black text contrast per step, pairs that reach your WCAG target and CSS variables.
intro: Builds a shade ramp from a brand colour and shows which text colours and step pairs meet a contrast target.
why:
Palettes made by eye often have text pairs that fail contrast.

This tool produces eleven steps from one brand colour, calculates the WCAG contrast of each with white and black, picks the best text colour, and lists which pairs inside the ramp reach 3, 4.5 or 7 to 1. It also suggests a darker brand variant for text on white if the brand colour is too light.
howTo: Read the table and the safe pairs.

faq.a: 4.5 for normal text at AA, 3 for large text and UI parts, 7 for AAA.

faq.q: Is the formula the WCAG one?
faq.a: Yes, the WCAG 2 relative luminance contrast ratio.
Use the Contrast Checker for APCA values.
